spans.s:
मि {c5c} U. (मिनोति, मिनुते; rarely
used in classical literature)
1 To
throw, cast, scatter.
--2 To build,
erect.
--3 To measure.
--4 To
establish.
--5 To observe, perceive.
--6
Ved. To fix in the earth.

मी {vI.v} {c9c} U. (मीनाति, मीनीते; seldom
used in classical literature)
1 To
kill, destroy, hurt, injure.
--2 To
lessen, diminish.
--3 To change,
alter.
--4 To transgress, violate.
--5
To disappear, be lost.
--6 To stray,
go astray. {vII.v} P., {c10c} U. (मयति,
माययति-ते)
1 To go, move.
--2 To
know, understand (गतिमत्ययोः). {vIII.v}
{c4c} A. (मीयते) To die, perish.
